heading: An editor for
Astro sites
blocks.intro:
CaraCMS lets the people who run a site change it in its own pages.
What they publish is JSON in the site’s git repository, which the site builds from.

blocks.heading: Content in git
blocks.body:
Every page is a JSON file in the site’s own repository.
A Publish is a commit to main, and the host deploys it like any other change.

media.alt: Paint swatches, fabric, stone and timber samples on marble

items.heading: Brand and settings
items.text: The site’s name, accent, logo and contact details, in Site Settings.

items.heading: Pages and blocks
items.text: Pages made of the site’s own blocks, edited where they sit, with a preview.

items.heading: Forms
items.text: Forms the site defines in code. What a visitor sends is kept, and sent on by email.
